comments.author: H.-Gazi

So far this skill can be pretty useful, just repeating the function of it:
1) Gives 4 % discount on provision per rank of it, so at rank 20 you've up to 80 % discount.
2) Increases the amount of supply convertation from trade goods. Like Tuna up to 28 food per use instead less of it.
3) Cheaper menu on tavern + course meal.
4) Essential requirement to learn "Range Barrel Trap" and "Wide Barrel Trap"

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A quick guide to those who wish to grind this skill efficiently:

1. Go to the docks of any city in the world (even supply ports) and select Ganador Transport.
2. Speak to Spy and click Ganador Mission Info.
3. Click Plan Mission. Select a green-name Ganador (or special guest Ganador with light pink/red name such as alveero, etc.) which costs 0 Patriot Awards.
4. Click OK, Yes to Plan Mission, then click Spy to select Ganador Mission Info again.
5. Click Details, Begin, Yes.
6. Go to docks from port official, switch to a ship with lots of cargo space, discard all food/water/timber/munitions and then open Provisions menu. Click 'Load water and food evenly' button, and accept the maximum amount of food/water.
7. Close Provisions menu, dump everything, and reload water and food evenly until you have gained as much skill proficiency as you like (for free). When you're finished, just click on End Ganador Battle and click Ganador Transport to return to the regular world.

Keep in mind Ganador battles eventually time out even if they do not begin, but it's easy to restart one for free (if needed). I hope this helps. Cheers, great online voyaging to you.
